# Support

Thanks for using Velt!

## Questions about Velt

This repo only holds the website and docs source. For questions, ideas and discussion about the language, use
[`velt-lang/velt`](https://github.com/velt-lang/velt) (issues or discussions there).

## Problems with the docs

If you've spotted a problem with the site itself (broken link, typo, wrong example, rendering bug, missing page), open an issue here:

- [Report a docs bug](https://github.com/velt-lang/velt-lang.github.io/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
- [Suggest content or improvements](https://github.com/velt-lang/velt-lang.github.io/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)

Include the URL of the affected page and a screenshot if relevant.

## Bugs in Velt itself

Compiler, runtime, standard library and tooling bugs go to <https://github.com/velt-lang/velt/issues>.

## Security vulnerabilities

**Please do not open a public issue for security problems.** See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

## Contributing

Pull requests are very welcome. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
